versions.subject: Merge PR #4997 from @MHaggis - Add rules related to PowerShell Web Access
versions.detection:
selection_install:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'Install-WindowsFeature WindowsPowerShellWebAccess'
selection_config:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'Install-PswaWebApplication'
selection_auth:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Add-PswaAuthorizationRule'
        - '-UserName *'
        - '-ComputerName *'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Install-WindowsFeature WindowsPowerShellWebAccess*" OR ScriptBlockText="*Install-PswaWebApplication*" OR (ScriptBlockText="*Add-PswaAuthorizationRule*" ScriptBlockText="*-UserName *" ScriptBlockText="*-ComputerName *")
